concept.subject: A space station drifting through a field of debris: a long cylinder with a big ring around its left end and a dark docking wheel at its right end, its antenna cables reaching up.
concept.composition: The big ring stands on the left as a tall ellipse seen at an angle, from two fifths to nine tenths of the height and from an eighth to a third of the width. The cylinder runs from its middle up to the right to the docking wheel, a dark disc at two thirds of the width and half the height, with a drum and a truss beyond it and two antenna cables rising from it toward the top center. The station's shadowed underside and drifting rocks fill the bottom, out-of-focus debris drifts through the space around, and the top center is open space.
concept.layout: 105 round pegs and 42 bricks. The docking wheel turns: its rim is four arcs of curved bricks with wide slots between them and six spoke pegs inside, around a still hub peg, a rotating group traced where the picture puts the disc. The big ring's hull is four brick arcs with docking gaps between them, and the lights of its inner deck are pegs gliding around inside it, past three still hub pegs. The cylinder's top is a solid that sheds balls toward the ring, with its underside a brick row sheltered under it. The truss, the drum, the boom and a module in the top right corner are short brick pieces; the cables, the underside's edges, the rocks and the drifting debris are pegs.

moving.what: the docking wheel's rim and spokes
the lights of the big ring's deck, gliding around inside it

difficulty.note: Middle of the stage: the turning wheel's slots open and close the way to its spokes, so the timing of a shot matters for the first time in the stage, and the solid cylinder top shelters the bricks under it.

background.prompt: A space station drifts in a soft lilac-gray outer space strewn with out-of-focus debris. A big ring stands on the left as a tall ellipse seen at an angle, from about two fifths to nine tenths of the picture height and from about an eighth to a third of the width, lit pale gray on its right and shadowed blue on its left. A long white cylinder runs from the ring's middle up to the right to a large dark docking disc at about two thirds of the width and half the height, with a lit drum and a truss beyond it; two thin antenna cables rise from the disc toward the top center. The station's shadowed blue underside spreads below the cylinder, small dark rocks drift along the bottom, a lit module edges into the top right corner and a solar panel reaches out to the left edge. The top center is open space.
